$comment: Allowlist for tools/ops-helper. This file is the authority for WHICH ops actions exist,
which services they may touch and how strict their gates are. The helper reads it once at
startup from a read-only mount of the repo; no MCP tool can change it. Editing it needs a
repo commit + an ops-helper restart - the same trust level as the helper's own source.
Anything not listed here is refused (fail closed). Code additionally enforces
forbidden_services/forbidden_operations: a mutating list may never name them, even if a
future edit of this file tried to add them.
forbidden_operations: docker volume rm / docker volume prune
any write to .env, secrets/ or data/
any change to hermes-test, the Hermes gateway or the ops-helper itself

ops_players.disabled_reason: paused: needs docker exec (POST /exec), which docker-socket-proxy denies (EXEC=0). Enable only with a path-scoped proxy that carries its own filter config.

ops_build_plugin.disabled_reason: paused: starting a throwaway container needs POST /containers/create, which docker-socket-proxy denies (POST=0). Enable only with a path-scoped proxy that carries its own filter config.

ops_run_tests.disabled_reason: paused: starting a throwaway container needs POST /containers/create, which docker-socket-proxy denies (POST=0). Enable only with a path-scoped proxy that carries its own filter config.

ops_restart_service.disabled_reason: paused: docker restart is a POST and docker-socket-proxy denies every non-GET request while POST=0 (ALLOW_RESTARTS has no effect without POST). Re-enable together with POST=1, or use a path-scoped proxy.

ops_backup_now.disabled_reason: paused: the helper image ships no PowerShell, so the repo's backup.ps1 cannot run here. Run backup.ps1 on the host.

ops_restart_game.disabled_reason: paused (T2): needs POST /containers/{id}/restart and docker exec for the announcement, both denied by docker-socket-proxy (POST=0, EXEC=0). Enable only with a path-scoped proxy.

ops_deploy_plugin.disabled_reason: paused (T2): needs a built artifact (container create) and docker exec for the announcement, both denied by docker-socket-proxy. Enable only with a path-scoped proxy.

ops_rollback_plugin.disabled_reason: paused (T2): needs POST /containers/{id}/restart and docker exec for the announcement, both denied by docker-socket-proxy. Enable only with a path-scoped proxy.
